title: Un-dismissable consent popup
summary: The homepage displays a consent popup that appears un-dismissable, potentially trapping users and increasing bounce rate.
problem: The homepage displays a consent popup that appears un-dismissable, potentially trapping users and violating user autonomy, which can increase bounce rate and erode trust.
recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.; cta: Shop All; notes: Ensure popup is dismissible with a clear close button, and avoid blocking content; use non-intrusive consent banners.
evidence: body_sample includes 'www.allbirds.com is blocked' repeated 5 times in h1s, suggesting a blocking overlay or popup; no close button or dismiss option is visible in the extracted content.
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 2.0-8.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Multiple competing CTAs
summary: The homepage hero presents multiple competing CTAs without a single clear primary action, diluting user focus.
problem: The homepage hero presents multiple competing CTAs (Shop All, Shop Womens, Shop Mens, etc.) without a single clear primary action, diluting user focus and reducing conversion likelihood.
recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.; cta: Single primary CTA: 'Shop Best Sellers' or 'Shop Women's'; notes: Reduce to one primary CTA in hero, with secondary CTAs de-emphasized or moved below the fold.
evidence: CTAs on homepage: 'Shop All', 'Shop Womens', 'Shop Mens', 'Shop Socks', 'Shop Women's Sale', 'Shop Men's Sale', 'SHOP MEN', 'SHOP WOMEN', 'Sign Up', 'Shop + -'
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Spec-forward hero copy
summary: The hero headline is abstract and doesn't mention shoes, comfort, or sustainability benefits, failing to address visitor intent.
problem: The hero headline 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' is abstract and feature-led, failing to directly address the visitor's intent to find comfortable, sustainable shoes, and the multiple 'blocked' H1s indicate a rendering issue that undermines clarity.
recommended_change: h1: Shoes That Feel Like Nothing. Made from Nature.; cta: Shop Best Sellers; notes: Rewrite to directly address visitor intent: comfortable, sustainable shoes. Use a clear CTA that guides to popular products.
evidence: H1s include 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' and multiple 'www.allbirds.com is blocked' entries; CTAs are generic 'Shop All', 'Shop Womens', 'Shop Mens'.
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Shipping delay warning
summary: The prominent 'orders may take up to 30 days to ship' warning creates immediate purchase anxiety and undermines trust.
problem: The prominent 'orders may take up to 30 days to ship' warning creates immediate purchase anxiety and undermines trust in delivery promises.
recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.; cta: Shop All; notes: Replace with a positive shipping message: 'Free shipping on orders over $100' and move any delay notice to a less prominent location or remove it if no longer accurate.
evidence: Body sample: 'Due to increased demand, orders may take up to 30 days to ship.'
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Free shipping threshold hidden
summary: The free shipping threshold is only mentioned in the body text, not prominently displayed near prices, causing potential surprise at checkout.
problem: The free shipping threshold is only mentioned in the body text, not prominently displayed near prices, causing potential surprise at checkout.
recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.; cta: Shop All; notes: Add a line near prices or in the hero: 'Free shipping on orders over $100' to set expectations early.
evidence: Body sample shows 'Free ground shipping on orders over $100' but the hero section and product cards display prices without any shipping threshold context.

title: Mega-menu choice overload
summary: The mega-menu presents 20+ nav items across multiple columns and categories, overwhelming users and increasing cognitive load.
problem: The mega-menu presents 20+ nav items across multiple columns and categories, overwhelming users and increasing cognitive load, which can lead to choice paralysis and reduced navigation efficiency.

title: Controls without accessible names
summary: 21 of 69 buttons expose no text label, so screen readers and voice control cannot address them.
problem: 21 of 69 buttons expose no text label, so screen readers and voice control cannot address them and the control is unusable.
recommended_change: notes: Give every control a visible text label or an aria-label. WCAG 2.2 AA, success criterion 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 21 of 69 <button> elements contain no text content and no aria-label.
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Images missing alternative text
summary: 12 of 55 images carry no alt attribute, losing both assistive technology support and image-search traffic.
problem: 12 of 55 images carry no alt attribute, losing both assistive technology support and the image-search traffic the alt text earns.
recommended_change: notes: Add descriptive alt text; use alt="" only for decorative images.
evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 12 of 55 elements have no alt attribute.
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 0.5-2.0% relative lift x $78 order value
